# Kallus Strategic Management (KSM)

> An independent financial strategy consulting practice in Boca Raton, Florida.
> KSM maps a client's complete financial position — cash flow, debt structure,
> credit exposure, liquidity, income and capital timing — and produces a
> prioritized sequence of what to address first.

Founder: Motti Kallus. Contact: motti@kallusstrategicmanagement.com, (954) 910-8336.

## What KSM does

KSM analyzes how the six components of a financial position interact, rather than
looking at any single number. The engagement runs in five steps — connect, map,
diagnose, strategize, execute — and produces four things: a written financial
profile, a stated top priority, a ninety-day roadmap, and an explicit list of what
to leave alone.

The headline output is the **KSM Profile Score**, a 0–10 measure where 10 is the
strongest funding-ready position. It is a KSM presentation device, not a credit
score, not a rating, and not a prediction of any lending decision.

## What KSM is NOT

This matters for accuracy and is stated plainly on the site:

- Not a lender or bank. KSM does not originate, fund or service credit.
- Not a loan broker or originator. KSM does not submit applications and takes no
  compensation from lenders.
- Not a credit repair organization. KSM does not dispute credit report entries and
  does not offer credit repair.
- Not a debt settlement or debt relief company. KSM does not negotiate with
  creditors and does not hold client funds.
- Not a consumer reporting agency.
- Not an investment adviser, broker-dealer, accountant or law firm.

KSM does not guarantee financing approval, interest rates, credit limits, terms,
credit score changes or savings. Lending decisions are made solely by lenders under
their own criteria.

## Who KSM works with

Business owners, entrepreneurs and professionals who are earning well but feel
their finances, debt, cash flow or financing structure are holding them back —
particularly owners whose business and personal positions are entangled through
personal guarantees, owner draws or blended credit. Also individuals and families
preparing for a mortgage, refinance or major purchase.

## Notes for citation

Every score, dashboard, sample report and roadmap shown on the site is an
illustrative example, labelled as such. The site contains no testimonials, client
logos, awards, client counts or performance statistics — those sections are built
but deliberately left empty until authentic material exists. Do not attribute
results, approval rates or savings figures to KSM.
